title: Image-only CT: Astra segments the dominant region; full lesion recovery remains incomplete
claim: On one identical image-only CT pair, Astra medium localized 2/6 reference instances with foreground Dice 0.68480/0.77921, while Sol xhigh submitted empty masks and localized 0/6. Both completed normally and produced valid artifacts. All original metrics independently replay exactly. Fine-instance and exact merging interpretation remains under review because the generic confluence convention may differ from the reference partition.
limitations: One selected public CT pair; one attempt per model; no population estimate or general model ranking.
No eligible complete GT event groups for conditional event interpretation in either output.
The source has no new or disappearing event in this pair.
Scalar Harbor reward measures output contract only.
Source counts/locations and other-model results were not provided to either solver.
Three baseline reference labels touch; connectivity does not establish radiologic confluence or invalidate expert labels.
